module.title: Server: Log: Request
module.description:
Log for requests on web applications.
Automatically logs all HTTP requests and CLI job calls.
module.author: Christian Würker
module.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_requests`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_requests` ( `requestId` int(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `ip` varchar(63) NOT NULL, `sessionId` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `method` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `request` text NOT NULL, `session` text DEFAULT NULL, `cookie` text DEFAULT NULL, `headers` text DEFAULT NULL, `timestamp` datetime(6) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`requestId`), KEY `ip` (`ip`), KEY `method` (`method`), KEY `url` (`url`), KEY `timestamp` (`timestamp`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
